non_applicable_dimensions.queues-jobs-dead-letters-ordering-backpr: No queue, broker, job runner, or background worker exists anywhere in the changed paths: a grep for threading, asyncio, queue, multiprocessing and the concurrent-futures pools returns zero in both the launcher and Orchestrate at cbc2fa19. Delivery is a synchronous subprocess chain in one foreground process and Orchestrate dispatches units by calling launch directly, so there is no asynchronous work item that could be duplicated, reordered, poisoned, or dead-lettered.

non_applicable_dimensions.pagination-rate-limits: The change exposes no collection interface with paging, cursors, quotas, or throttling. The only list reads the launcher performs are single-shot local-socket calls returning their whole result in one object, with no page token, no limit parameter, no ordering guarantee to preserve, and no rate-limit signal in the response shape. The launcher owns no network service and serves no clients, so there is no volume boundary to score.
